name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — Advanced — The Gift of Servitude

system.activation: The culmination of Taking of the Spirit, this power binds the will of a victim who has no Mental Traits remaining. Spend a Willpower Trait and win a Social Challenge against him; he is affected exactly as if bound by the Dominate power Conditioning for one week. Losing the Social Challenge bars further attempts on that target for a full year.
